name: Fallen Starlight
description: Recover Astral Shards for the observers at Asterwatch.

dialogue.offer: The horrors in Starfall Basin carry fragments of the sky. Bring me five Astral Shards to study.
dialogue.in_progress: Five shards should reveal whether the stars fell by chance or design.
dialogue.ready: They are resonating with the observatory lens. This is an extraordinary find.
dialogue.completed: The shards mapped a path no ordinary telescope could see.
